brief: Players enter a quiet loading bay with minimal visual interest. A breadcrumb trail of overturned crates leads into a maze where enemies hide behind cover. A fake dead end closet reveals itself as an ambush point after the player picks up a shotgun. The final open arena exit allows for a conclusive battle against multiple enemies.
pacing_notes: Build tension through quiet sections before sudden ambushes and explosive combat.

rubric_hints.navigation: Use crate maze to obscure player path while maintaining clear sightlines for enemies
rubric_hints.pacing: Balance quiet exploration with sudden combat moments to maintain player engagement
rubric_hints.mechanics: Position closet ambush to require player to interact with environment before combat
rubric_hints.affordances: Ensure crates provide cover and closet offers hiding spot that appears safe but is not
rubric_hints.narrative: Establish a sense of discovery through the dusty, abandoned warehouse setting

seed.structure: quiet loading bay -> crate maze breadcrumbs -> fake dead end closet release -> open loading arena exit
seed.mechanics: monster closet after shotgun pickup; crate cover
seed.tone: dusty browns, sudden noise after silence
